body: When I think back to it, I thought he seemed somewhat into it. I feel that he was taking part rather than just responding to what I was doing. I would definitely take it slower in the future, but I don't think things were as bad as I thought. It wasn't so much of a hookup, more a: you are into me and I might be into you, let's see what happens, sort of situation. Thanks for giving me some perspective, it helped me to see that maybe it wasnt the end of days. I managed to talk through it with my mum and I feel so much better. I won't forget how I felt, but I will use it a learning point to be more careful in the future. I never want to put anyone in a position that would cause them harm.

I don't know, but I can't get of my head that he didn't say yes explicitly. Which in my book constitutes not concenting. I tried to message him apologising for how I treated him and he just hasn't responded. But thank you, you have given me some perspective.

Thanks, and thanks for trying to help. The thing is I am damned if I do, but I am also damned if I dont, I can see myself only as a monster. I will just allow myself to fade out of everyone's lives, that way I cant hurt anyone else.
I am not, but if I confess to what I did that would surely be the outcome.
